title: SyncPolicyManualDefaults controls the default behavior of a manual sync

applyOnly.title: ApplyOnly specifies whether manual syncs should use apply-only strategy by default (default: false)

dryRun.title: DryRun specifies whether manual syncs should be performed as a dry run by default (default: false)

force.title: Force specifies whether manual syncs should supply --force to kubectl by default (default: false)

prune.title: Prune specifies whether to delete resources from the cluster that are not found in the sources anymore as part of manual sync (default: true)
